recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If implementers still need more explicit choice-element examples, refine the cross-version package or FAQ guidance rather than duplicating details in core versions.html.
issue_request: FHIR-31348 asked the FHIR-core versions/compatibility guidance to clarify allowable cross-version extension URLs for polymorphic elements. The Published/Persuasive resolution said polymorphic extension URLs use the base element, such as extension-Observation.value; cross-version extensions must not convey datatypes already supported by the transmitted version; and an extension for the same FHIR version as the instance is an error.
initial_application: Commit a6c96740e3c077f3b8c13ce548cfe58c25c80686 directly applied FHIR-31348 to source/versions.html, adding the Observation.value example for added choice types and the same-version error rule. Related R5-era commits for FHIR-36702 and FHIR-31721 expanded the same section with additional cross-version extension guidance.
additional_context: Commit f45505e5b3aa0d87effb991938750e627b782d2d later moved detailed cross-version content out of core versions.html and into individual cross-version definition packages. The current active versions.html remains in build scope through publish.ini, defines the URL pattern and package matrix, and points readers to package details. The R5-to-R4 XVer package now defines Observation.value[x] with official URL http://hl7.org/fhir/5.0/StructureDefinition/extension-Observation.value, preserving the seed rule in the package-owned artifact.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Restoring the removed FHIR-31348 prose in core would duplicate package-owned guidance and partially reverse the later R6 content move.
